runtime_observations: The '?step=basic' anchor is not a safe way to peek at step 2; the server bounces to step 1.
Rich text fields persist to the user's profile ('We will save this field for future applications'), so writes here have side effects beyond this application.
Trix toolbar buttons are <button> without type=submit; the only submit control on step 1 is 'Next'.
A Hotjar iframe (about:blank) is present; no captcha widget on step 1.

provider_hint.for_jev: getonbrd: 3-step, logged-in form. Step 1 has two rich-text narrative fields with hard min/max character limits (experience 300-2000, education 100-2000) and an English-level self-assessment dropdown. Classify the two editors as free_text_narrative -> writer with explicit length constraints; english_level is option_choice requiring a verified fact. Never read or export the profile name/email shown on the page. Stop before any submit on the Preview step.
option_choice_from_verified_facts: english_level (CEFR band) only if the candidate profile states it
escalate_to_writer_opus: professional_background (300-2000 chars, plain prose acceptable in Trix)
requires_human_input: confirmation that profile fields may be overwritten (fields persist to profile)

edge_cases: Character limits are counted on text content, but the hidden input stores Trix HTML; writer output must be measured as plain text.
The form's hidden 'answers' input suggests employer questions may be serialised as JSON rather than as individual controls on later steps.
